does: Executes an ApplyStatus functor on a target: reads the caster's character or item, its SpellId, concentration and health, and applies the functor's status; its expression evaluation can roll (a roll of type None with no roller).

evidence.says: case 1 of the functor type switch in unplaced::ExecuteAttackTargetFunctor calls it; it takes a SpellId and reads esv::Character, esv::Item, eoc::ConcentrationComponent and eoc::HealthComponent

the None roll between a goblin's weapon attack and its damage comes through RollManager::RollDice <- RollDamageExpressionDice (bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x11939C1) <- 0x1052660 (bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x1052736) <- this (bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x377BF00), inside Target_MainHandAttack's SpellProperties functors

questions.ask: Which status and which expression the None roll evaluates: snapshot the functor (argument 2) and read its StatusId/Duration; ApplyStatus is functor type 1 in the extender's FunctorId.
